text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I am terribly sorry...! To skip training 
without notice, I...
choice_data_list: I wonder if something urgent came up?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... the historical documents were about 
to overflow from the shelves, so I was 
organizing them... but I just can't seem 
to sort through them...
choice_data_list:
That might be a bit tough for Chrono, 
though...
That might be a bit tough for Chrono...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Fearing that getting rid of them 
would break tradition, we haven't been 
able to come up with a clear 
countermeasure...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Before I realized it, so much time had 
passed... I will be far more careful from 
now on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how downcast she looks, it seems 
she's properly reflecting on what 
happened. Let's have her give it her all 
again starting tomorrow.
